messages:
maya: hey team — new hire Ana (F-1) is joining 7/20, her DSO said they'll release SEVIS on 7/9. can we confirm onboarding timeline and whether i9 / benefits can be done before SEVIS release?

leo: quick q — is she on OPT or still on CPT? need to know if there's an EAD. do we have SEVIS ID + current I-20?

ana: hi! i'm Ana (not yet in this channel). i'm on post-completion OPT application (applied 05/02), current I-20 attached to my school. DSO said they'll release SEVIS record on 07/09. SEVIS ID: N123456789. passport expires 02/2027.

leo: thanks. important note: paid employment requires valid EAD (post-completion OPT) or other work auth. if the EAD isn't active by start, we can still do orientation and paperwork, but no paid tasks. benefits enrollment starts on first paid day.

immigration-vendor: we can verify everything. please collect these items and upload to secure portal or share with DSO for release:
```
- passport bio page
- I-94 (cbp)
- current I-20 with SEVIS ID
- USCIS receipt notice (Form I-797 if available)
- EAD card (if issued)
```
we'll confirm once DSO releases SEVIS. if EAD arrives after release, update us with a scan.

people-ops-bot: [TASK CREATED] Onboard: Ana — collect docs, confirm EAD timeline, set contingent start

maya: ok let's make pay-effective date the EAD start. leo, set onboarding to "orientation-only" 7/20 and add a note to the offer. cc payroll so benefits are held until work auth confirmed. :white_check_mark:

leo: will update offer addendum: "Orientation on 07/20 is unpaid; employment shall commence upon employee providing proof of work authorization (EAD)." pinging @payroll.

payroll: got it — we'll hold benefits enrollment and first payroll until we get EAD and i-9 docs. please send docs to payroll@redwood.com once verified.

ana: thanks everyone — i'll upload docs to the portal today and ask my DSO to confirm release on 07/09. i'll post confirmation here.

leo: checklist for our side:
1) add contingent clause to offer (leo)
2) schedule orientation 7/20 unpaid (leo)
3) track doc intake in onboarding tracker (maya)
4) verify EAD + run i-9 same day EAD starts (immigration-vendor / payroll)

maya: perfect. i'll follow up 07/10 to confirm DSO released SEVIS. if anything changes we can move orientation.

people-ops-bot: [REMINDER] Check Ana document packet on 2024-07-10
